This is the Gaza Dispatch audio briefing for July 16, 2026.

Here are the key source-backed developments from today's edition.

1. Palestinians fight fires after settler attacks in the occupied West Bank. Overnight Israeli settler attacks set farmlands ablaze in Masafer Yatta and burned vehicles near Tulkarem. This was reported by Al Jazeera.

2. Palestinians in Gaza search through homes destroyed by Israeli strikes. Palestinians are inspecting the damage in Nuseirat after Israeli strikes reduced their homes to rubble. This was reported by Al Jazeera.

For the full source-backed dispatch, read the July 16, 2026 Gaza edition at dispatches.thebluefernco.com.
